title: Set a box up, run 100 copies of it in the background, compare them
question: The dials and the RUN button are on the rack page rather than anywhere else, because a batch makes chambers and this is the page chambers live on. Is that where you would look for it -- and are COPIES and TICKS the two dials you want, or is there a third?
context_md:
**Your question had an answer and it is the opposite of the worry.** The engine is deterministic by requirement, so copies made without touching the seed are *bit-identical* -- a hundred of them are one sample wearing a hundred labels. Vary the seed and there is almost too much variation.

Measured on the shipped bed, 9,000 ticks a copy:

| | plants | plant cells | animals | seeds sown |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 4 copies at **one seed** | 1.00x | 1.00x | 1.00x | 1.00x |
| 12 copies at **12 seeds** | **2.42x** | **2.62x** | **3.12x** | **2.53x** |

So there is plenty to select on -- and that spread is also the bar. Two chambers differing by 2x means nothing on its own, because two chambers that differ by *nothing at all* already do.

The box on screen keeps working while the copies run. On this 4-core box a copy is about 8 seconds of wall clock per 9,000 ticks.
